title: The build is a reusable workflow
rationale: CI and release must build the same way; one reusable workflow guarantees it.
hint: Move build steps into build.yml with on: workflow_call and call it from ci.yml and release.yml.

title: Releases are cut from version tags
rationale: A tag is an immutable, reviewable release trigger; no manual uploads.
hint: Trigger release.yml on push of tags v*.

title: Release notes are generated from merged PRs
rationale: With Conventional Commit titles the notes write themselves.

title: Superseded CI runs are cancelled
rationale: Saves minutes and keeps the latest result the only one that matters.

title: End-to-end tests run against the built artefact in the pipeline
rationale: Bundling and runtime issues only show in the real build.

title: Hosted projects get a preview deploy per pull request
rationale: Reviewers should see the change running, not imagine it.
